commands: lsuser -a login rlogin shell account_locked ALL
blurb: This check confirms the uucp system account has every login path closed and is locked. The uucp account belongs to a legacy file-transfer service and is not meant for anyone to sign in to. If it keeps a usable local or remote login path, an attacker who takes it over can use this trusted system account to move or alter transferred files and hide their activity.
